title: Add error boundaries, chat store memory limit, and abort controllers
description:
**Bug 1**: `dashboard/src/app/App.tsx:10-139` — Lazy-loaded pages have no React error boundary. A failed chunk load or component error crashes the entire app.

**Bug 2**: `dashboard/src/state/chat.ts` — Chat store has no memory limit. Viewing 100+ runs accumulates all messages indefinitely (unlike events.ts which caps at 120).

**Bug 3**: `dashboard/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts:14-19` — No abort controller for chat queries. Rapid run switching causes stale data overwrites.

**Bug 4**: `dashboard/src/pages/AuthCallbackPage.tsx:36-47` — `getSession()` errors are silently swallowed in catch block.

**Fix 1**: Wrap routes in an ErrorBoundary component with a fallback UI and retry button.
**Fix 2**: Cap chat threads at ~50 most recent, evicting oldest when exceeded.
**Fix 3**: Pass abort signal to the query function via React Query's signal parameter.
**Fix 4**: Log error and show a warning toast when session fetch fails.

**Files**: `dashboard/src/app/App.tsx`, `dashboard/src/state/chat.ts`, `dashboard/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts`, `dashboard/src/pages/AuthCallbackPage.tsx`

reopenReason:
DoD item 1 ("Error boundary wraps lazy routes with fallback UI") not met.

App.tsx has no ErrorBoundary component. No ErrorBoundary exists anywhere in the dashboard (grep returns 0 matches). The step-1 plan said to create an ErrorBoundary component and wrap routes, but this was never done.

A failed chunk load or component runtime error will crash the entire app with a white screen.

Fix: Create `dashboard/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx` as a class component with getDerivedStateFromError + retry button. Wrap the `<Suspense>` blocks in App.tsx with `<ErrorBoundary>`.

Note: DoD items 2-4 are satisfied since the target files (chat.ts, useRunChat.ts, AuthCallbackPage.tsx) were deleted in the dashboard rebuild.
